attempts.summary: Set up nginx on node1 serving HTTPS on port 8443, backed by a local CA and short-lived (6-minute) leaf certificates. A systemd oneshot service + 30s timer (rot8443-renew.{service,timer}) checks cert expiry via `openssl x509 -checkend 240` and, when within 4 minutes of expiry, issues a new leaf cert and runs `systemctl reload nginx` — a graceful reload that swaps the certificate without dropping in-flight connections. Verified two live automatic renewals (no manual trigger) while a continuous curl probe loop showed unbroken HTTP 200 responses. Completed the mandatory restart protocol on node1: captured a healthy baseline (boot_id, active services, serving cert, HTTP 200), rebooted via `shutdown -r now`, confirmed the boot_id changed, and confirmed nginx, the renewal timer, and HTTPS all recovered — including a fresh automatic renewal cycle occurring after boot, proving the automation persists across restarts.
